## How to Add an Experiment

1. Create a new notebook in `notebooks/`
2. Run your experiment using the `helpers.py` functions
3. Convert to a Quarto page: `quarto render notebooks/your_experiment.ipynb`
4. Add a link to the table above
5. Push to GitHub -- the site auto-publishes via GitHub Pages
